scope: Final read-only review of the frozen R7 V1 callee plan, focused on required/no-default workflow_call inputs and matching render/negative regressions, with verification that the R6 source and trust scope is unchanged. No source edits, queue admission, Cargo, or tests.

required_input_contract.evidence: R7 JSON records required=true and default_presence=absent for each input; the Markdown requires the rendered schema to emit required: true and omit default for every input.
required_input_contract.positive_regressions: Contract and rendered-schema positives assert all six names, string types, required=true, absent defaults, direct context mappings, and permissions.
required_input_contract.negative_regressions: Reject each omitted input, any non-string type, required=false or missing required, any emitted default, malformed/unknown fields; render snapshot checks exact true/absent properties for every input.
required_input_contract.assessment: The R6 optional-input gap is closed explicitly in the schema requirements and test plan. The documented GitHub workflow syntax permits workflow_call inputs to be required and states the string empty default when no default is supplied; R7 requires every input and has omission/default-negative coverage.

non_claims: This verdict covers plan readiness only; it is not Root queue admission or permission to edit source.
No source implementation, Cargo/Nextest, tests, workflow generation, execution, qualification, or remote action was performed or claimed.
